grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 is the year of multiplication and division. Master the facts, then use them for area, rounding and word problems.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 is the year of multi-digit multiplication, long division and fractions. Build fluency with big numbers, then use it for fractions, decimals, measurement and angles.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 builds strong number sense: facts within 20, adding and subtracting within 100 and 1000, place value, money, time and measuring. Short lessons and lots of practice make it stick.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 brings fractions and decimals to full strength: add fractions with unlike denominators, multiply and divide fractions and decimals, and find volume. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 is the bridge to algebra: ratios, rates and percents, dividing fractions, negative numbers, expressions and equations, area and surface area, and statistics. Short lessons with step-by-step examples, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 builds the base for all of math: adding and subtracting within 20, tens and ones, counting to 120, telling time, measuring and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 is the year of the times tables: pupils learn all facts up to 12 × 12 for the Multiplication Tables Check. They also work with 4-digit numbers, fractions and decimals, area and perimeter, and the 12- and 24-hour clock.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 brings together everything from primary school maths ready for the KS2 SATs: long multiplication and division, fractions, decimals and percentages, ratio, algebra, angles, area and volume, and statistics.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 builds confidence with numbers to 1,000, the 3, 4 and 8 times tables, column addition and subtraction, fractions, money, time and measuring. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 takes numbers to a million and decimals to three places: long and short multiplication, short division, fractions and percentages, measuring angles with a protractor, area and perimeter, and line graphs.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 builds number sense to 100: place value, number bonds, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, fractions, money, time and shapes. Short lessons with pictures, then lots of practice.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 is where maths begins: counting to 100, number bonds to 10 and 20, adding and subtracting within 20, halves and quarters, money, time and shapes. Picture-based lessons and practice for 5 and 6 year olds.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 3
grades.intro: Year 3 maths builds strong number skills: numbers beyond 10 000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 3, 4, 5 and 10, fractions, money, time and chance. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 5
grades.intro: Year 5 maths moves to decimals with more than 2 places, percentages, factors and multiples, multiplying and dividing larger numbers, angles in degrees, area and perimeter, and line graphs. Great preparation for NAPLAN numeracy.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 4
grades.intro: Year 4 maths builds on Year 3: multiplication facts to 10 × 10, decimals with tenths and hundredths, equivalent fractions, larger numbers, money, time with am and pm, angles, symmetry and chance.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 6
grades.intro: Year 6 maths gets students ready for high school: integers, prime and square numbers, fractions, decimals and percentages, order of operations, the area of a rectangle, angles, the Cartesian plane and probability.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 1
grades.intro: Year 1 maths: numbers to 120, tens and ones, adding and subtracting within 20, skip counting, sharing, patterns, measuring, shapes, position, data and chance, with a picture in almost every question.

grades.subject: maths
grades.name: Year 2
grades.intro: Year 2 maths: numbers to 1000, addition facts to 20, adding and subtracting 2-digit numbers, twos and doubling, equal groups, money, halves, quarters and eighths, time to the quarter-hour, shapes and graphs.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 3
grades.intro: Grade 3 math in Ontario: numbers to 1000, adding and subtracting with regrouping, multiplication facts for 2, 5 and 10, fair shares and fractions, money and making change, time, measurement, data and probability. Great practice for the Grade 3 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 6
grades.intro: Grade 6 math in Ontario: fractions, decimals and percents, integers, ratios and rates, equations and inequalities, area of polygons, angles, the Cartesian plane, data, probability and financial literacy. Great practice for the Grade 6 EQAO assessment.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 math in British Columbia: numbers to 10 000, multiplication and division facts, fractions, decimals to hundredths, one-step equations, patterns, 12- and 24-hour time, polygons, perimeter, symmetry, graphs, probability and money. Great practice for the Grade 4 FSA.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 7
grades.intro: Grade 7 math in British Columbia: integer and decimal operations, order of operations, fractions, decimals, ratios and percents, two-step equations, linear relations, circles, volume, the Cartesian plane, transformations, circle graphs, probability and financial percentages. Great practice for the Grade 7 FSA.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 1
grades.intro: Grade 1 math in Ontario: numbers to 50, counting by 2s, 5s and 10s, addition and subtraction facts, word problems, halves and fourths, patterns, sorting and graphs, shapes, measuring, the calendar and Canadian coins.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 2
grades.intro: Grade 2 math in Ontario: numbers to 200, counting by 20s, 25s and 50s, odd and even, adding and subtracting to 100, equal groups, fair shares, patterns, graphs, shapes and symmetry, measuring in cm and m, time and money.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 4
grades.intro: Grade 4 math in Ontario: numbers to 10 000, multiplication facts to 10 × 10, multiplying and dividing by one-digit numbers, fractions, decimal tenths, equations, data, probability, angles, coordinates, elapsed time, area and money.

grades.subject: math
grades.name: Grade 5
grades.intro: Grade 5 math in Ontario: numbers to 100 000, facts to 12 × 12, two-digit multiplication and division, fractions, decimals and percents, ratios, equations, data, probability, triangles, transformations, angles, area and financial literacy.
